cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(nsx_usb_policy C CXX ASM)
include("${NSX_TEST_HARNESS_ROOT}/tests/hardware/common/firmware.cmake")
if(NOT NSX_TEST_BOARD STREQUAL "apollo4p_blue_kxr_evb")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "USB policy smoke supports AP4 Blue KXR")
endif()
nsx_add_test_firmware(usb_policy main.c MODULES interrupt timer power)
target_compile_definitions(usb_policy PRIVATE NSX_TEST_USB_KEEP=$<BOOL:${NSX_TEST_USB_KEEP}>)
target_link_options(usb_policy PRIVATE "LINKER:--wrap=am_bsp_low_power_init")
